receipt.public_excerpt: Qwen3-32B-Base achieves 65.54 on MMLU-Pro and 39.78 on SuperGPQA, significantly outperforming its predecessor Qwen2.5-32B-Base.

evidence_items.explanation: The report documents gains in the pretrained base model under a common evaluation pipeline, separately from its later reasoning post-training. Its architecture, data, and training improvements supply another route to capability gains, contradicting the claim of exclusivity.

evidence_items.locator: Section 1, paragraph discussing OpenAI o1 and inference-time scaling

receipt.public_excerpt: This approach has achieved significant improvements in various reasoning tasks, such as mathematics, coding, and scientific reasoning.

evidence_items.explanation: The preceding sentence identifies the approach as increasing chain-of-thought length. This supports the narrower contention that additional inference reasoning can improve performance, but not that it was the only available route.

unresolved_gaps: The sources do not quantify how much of any industry-wide inference-cost increase came from longer reasoning.
They do not establish a quantitative threshold at which pretraining returns became a wall.
